title: Inside "MR ROBOT" - Anatomy of a Malware-as-a-Service Operation Targeting Indian Bank Customers

title: September 2026 Infostealer Trend Report
content: During September 2026, infostealers were primarily distributed through SEO poisoning, disguised as illegal software such as cracks and keygens. Major distribution platforms included Mediafire, AWS S3, Mega, and Cloudflare Storage. title: Inside Qilin ransomware: ESXi attacks, affiliate networks and double extortion
content: Qilin, also known as Agenda, is a Russian-speaking ransomware-as-a-service operation active since 2022 that became one of the most prolific groups by 2025 with over 1,000 claimed victims.
